text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Iraqi press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Iraq is capable to meet its export ceiling under the second phase of its oil-for-food deal with the U.N.
- Russian airlines asks U.N. to allow it to transport donated medicine to Iraq.
- The second oil supertanker leaves Turkey's Ceyhan after loading with Iraqi crude.
- Several Kurds stage a protest in front of the U.N. office in Baghdad calling for the withdrawal of foreign troops from northern Iraq.
- U.N. coordinator in Baghdad lauds Iraq's cooperation with the world body to implement the oil-for-food deal.
